screen.headline: YOUR STORY STARTS HERE
screen.intro: Towns to discover. Strangers with stories. A place to write your own.

tips.menu: Press ESC for the Wraith menu: map, settings and quit.
tips.creator: Take your time creating your character; the wardrobe can change your look later.
tips.horse: Care for your horse: brush and feed it to raise the bond and its stats.
tips.needs: Watch hunger and thirst on the HUD; food and drink are sold in the stores.
tips.stables: Stables sell horses, keep them and repair their tack.
tips.law: Mind the town laws; the law watches the towns and the roads.
